How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 03-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Silchar?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Silchar is September 3, 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Tech/ME degree in ECE/EE/E&I with a valid GATE score to be eligible for the Junior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/WOMEN/PWD candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA at 10%.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Silchar?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email with all required documents attached. The specific email address will be provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position at the National Institute of Technology Silchar.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is NITS/Dean(R&C)/ECE/721/01/2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where is NIT Silchar located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Silchar is located in Silchar, Assam.
